## One source, three outputs

- Browser-based Reveal.js presentation
- Downloadable PowerPoint deck
- Downloadable PDF presentation

## A simple result

For the observations $2, 4, 6, 8$:

$$
\bar{x} = \frac{2 + 4 + 6 + 8}{4} = 5.
$$

## Authoring guidance

- Separate slides with level-two headings
- Prefer portable Markdown constructs
- Preview all three formats before publishing
